reading: Collins English Dictionary chose mogging as its word of the year.
Mogging means doing better than someone or getting more attention than them.
People often use this word to talk about how someone looks.
It became much more common in 2026.
Young people use it online and in everyday conversation.
It can be a joke about someone or a way to say something nice about them.
How people understand it can change with the situation.
Collins uses social media to learn how English is changing.
Its dictionary team checks how often people use words.

vocabulary.definition: Picked one person or thing from several.
The interest people show when they watch or listen to someone.
What is happening at a particular time and place.

entries.ja: 複数の人や物の中から、一人または一つを選んだ。
entries.ko: 여러 사람이나 물건 중에서 한 사람이나 한 가지를 골랐다.
entries.zh-Hans: 从多个人或事物中选出了一个。
entries.es: Eligió a una persona o una cosa entre varias.
entries.pt-BR: Escolheu uma pessoa ou uma coisa entre várias.
entries.fr: A choisi une personne ou une chose parmi plusieurs.
entries.de: Wählte eine Person oder eine Sache aus mehreren aus.

entries.ja: 誰かを見たり、その人の話を聞いたりするときに示す関心。
entries.ko: 누군가를 보거나 그 사람의 말을 들을 때 사람들이 보이는 관심.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们在看某个人或听某个人说话时表现出的兴趣。
entries.es: El interés que muestran las personas cuando miran o escuchan a alguien.
entries.pt-BR: O interesse que as pessoas demonstram quando olham para alguém ou escutam essa pessoa.
entries.fr: L’intérêt que les gens montrent lorsqu’ils regardent ou écoutent quelqu’un.
entries.de: Das Interesse, das Menschen zeigen, wenn sie jemanden ansehen oder ihm zuhören.

entries.ja: よく使われたり、よく見られたりする。
entries.es: Que se usa o se ve a menudo.
entries.pt-BR: Que é usado ou visto com frequência.
entries.fr: Qui est souvent utilisé ou vu.

entries.ja: 人と人が話をすること。
entries.fr: Un échange de paroles entre des personnes.

entries.ja: ある特定の時間と場所で起きていること。
entries.ko: 특정한 시간과 장소에서 일어나고 있는 일.
entries.zh-Hans: 在特定时间和地点正在发生的事情。
entries.es: Lo que está ocurriendo en un momento y lugar determinados.
entries.pt-BR: O que está acontecendo em um determinado momento e lugar.
entries.fr: Ce qui se passe à un moment et dans un lieu précis.
entries.de: Das, was zu einer bestimmten Zeit an einem bestimmten Ort geschieht.
